periods.time: five years after Arcadia Empire coup
periods.label: Former prince becomes first male student and reveals Bahamut
titles: former seventh prince of the Arcadia Empire
first male student of the Royal Officer Academy
periods.nationality: former Arcadia Empire; Atismata New Kingdom resident under special pardon
periods.affiliation: Royal Officer Academy; Atismata New Kingdom under pardon

status.legal: pardoned former imperial criminal with debt and black collar
status.secret_identity: Black Hero who destroyed the old empire's Drag-Ride army

appearance.overview: silver-white hair inherited from the old imperial line, youthful face, black criminal collar

personality.summary: self-effacing, protective, guilt-ridden, and unable to abandon people in danger
personality.inner_conflict: wants to save people despite believing he failed as a prince and is unfit to be a hero

quote_samples: 我不是什么英雄。而是推翻帝国的最弱机龙使。

habits.daily_routine: accepts public chore requests while attending academy after admission

background.upbringing: cast out from the palace young and later used his position and Drag-Ride skill to plan the empire's overthrow
background.pre_story: received special pardon after the coup and worked for citizens to repay enormous debt

lisha-atismata.summary: initially accused by Lisha, later earns her trust, keeps her brand secret, and saves her from Belbet

airi-arcadia.summary: mutually protective; Airi monitors Bahamut risk and warns him not to expose himself

philuffy-aingram.summary: she treats him as unchanged from childhood and shelters him in her room

krulcifer-einfolk.summary: he trades knowledge of the Black Hero to secure her battlefield support

fugil-arcadia.summary: Fugil manipulated Lux's coup plan and destroyed the imperial court for his own purpose

belbet-balt.summary: Lux defeats Belbet and his rebel Drag-Ride force with Bahamut

periods.summary: Lux is the former seventh prince of the fallen Arcadia Empire. Publicly known as the harmless weakest undefeated chore prince, he enters the girls' Royal Officer Academy after an accidental bath incident, protects Lisha and the students, and finally reveals Bahamut to defeat Belbet's imperial remnant attack.

key_events.summary: Falls through the roof into the academy bath while recovering a stolen bag.
Fights Lisha defensively, then protects the audience from a Gargoyle Abyss.
Deploys Bahamut and defeats Belbet, the imperial remnants, and remaining Abyss.
Accepts Lisha's order and remains as the academy's first male student.
